newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Aer Lingus appoints Dutch GSA.
newsitem.headline: Aer Lingus appoints Dutch GSA.

text.p: Aer Lingus, Ireland's national carrier, has appointed a Netherlands general sales agent.
Fred Veenendaal, director of the GSA, VIA, said the appointment becomes effective from February 1.
VIA has been the Dublin-based carrier's GSA in Belgium for 18 months, he added.
Aer Lingus operates four daily Boeing 737-500 flights to Amsterdam's Schiphol Airport. Veenendaal said hi-tech and electronic products are expected to be the major exports from Ireland.
VIA is also a GSA for Air Canada and Lauda Air. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
